justification: Data-registration script only (no product logic): wires Wingecarribee into the existing VerifyOpsBot monitoring. 3 dcp_chapter_registry rows (SHA-256 baselines computed from the verified cached PDFs, baseline copies uploaded to R2), the 32 numeric control rows linked via source_chapter_key (closes the dcp_watchdog blind-spot check; enables change-triggered needs_review), and the Wingecarribee LEP registered in instrument_registry for the legislation monitor. Verified post-run: 3 confirmed registry rows with hash+R2 path, 0 unlinked controls, LEP watch active.

break_it.scenario: The monitor watches the wrong URL (hand-built planURL with normalised spacing) and every weekly check 404s, incrementing check_failures forever
break_it.what_happens: Silent monitoring failure — the one thing the registration exists to prevent
break_it.how: council_url values are the EXACT planURLs returned by the Portal /dcp endpoint (the irregular double-spaces are real and were proven load-bearing when a hand-built URL 404ed during Phase-0); baseline hashes were computed from PDFs fetched via those exact URLs
break_it.repro: curl each council_url in the script returns %PDF; ce-wingecarribee-numeric-onboarding-2026-07.md records the 404 lesson

post_merge.manual_verify: No — registration verified post-run in this session (3 registry rows confirmed+hashed+R2, 0 unlinked controls, LEP watch active); the next weekly r2_monitor run exercises it end-to-end.
